context: Create an interactive VR scene for banana farm management featuring mango plants at different growth stages, suckers, banana bunches, irrigation systems, and drainage channels. Allow users to inspect plants, monitor soil moisture, apply fertilizers, remove excess suckers, and identify banana-specific diseases such as Panama disease and Sigatoka leaf spot, with the environment responding to their actions. Include a timeline showing the banana crop lifecycle from planting to harvesting over 9–15 months, with plant growth, soil conditions, disease alerts, irrigation needs, and harvest readiness changing dynamically based on farm management decisions.

analysis.summary: An interactive VR scene for banana farm management with mango plants and other elements, allowing users to manage the farm and see the lifecycle of the banana crop.
